name: Alzament (Alza.cz house brand)
summary: House filament brand of Czech online retailer Alza.cz (Prague), sold across Alza's country sites: basic, matte, silk and chameleon PLA, Hyper PLA+ / PLA+, PETG and Hyper PETG, PLA-CF, PETG-CF, ASA, ABS and TPU 95A at budget prices (Basic PLA 1 kg 249 CZK). Alza does not name the extruder.

oem_relationships.notes: Alza.cz a.s. (company ID 27082440) lists Alzament under 'Our brands - 3D printer filament' (https://www.alza.cz/EN/3d-printer-filament/our-brands/28855595-e71.htm; seen in search results, page returned 403 to fetch).
Alza is a retailer and states no maker. Sourcing is inferred from the house-brand model only; no named OEM and no origin evidence, so no country is asserted.

product_lines.name: Alzament Chameleon PLA
product_lines.notes: Colour-shift effect PLA; finish not described in the notes, so no effect id is asserted.

product_lines.name: Alzament Hyper PLA+ / PLA+
product_lines.notes: 'Hyper' is high-speed positioning; TDS at dwn.alza.cz/manual/148631. Some reviews report clogging at high speed.

additional_notes: 24-month warranty. Analogous retailer house brands in the catalog: Insignia, Michaels, Hobby Lobby, Amazon Basics. Customer reviews on alza.cz complain that Hyper PLA clogs or cannot handle high speed.

provenance.conflicts: Alza pages (alza.cz 'Our brands', alza.at brand page) still return 403 to every fetch (re-checked 2026-11-06), so the parent-company link rests on search results showing Alzament only on Alza domains. Identity medium confidence; manufacturer unknown (low).
